question.text: Select which type of overlapping is responsible for <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math>-character in <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>–</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math> bond of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>

solution.text: <math><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mo>-</mo></math> character is due to  <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mo>←</mo><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi></math>  back bonding between  <math><mn>3</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi></math>  orbital of  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></math>  and  <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></math>  orbital of N.
